title: Specific visual references and within-image composition
subtitle: Paper example (Fig. 2, single-image layout) · 6 construction steps
provenance: Construction steps documented in the paper (Fig. 2, Sections 3.1–3.3 and 3.5)

images.alt: Film still showing a man in a cream racing suit raising both hands on the left (target A) and a man wearing a black cap on the right (target B)
images.caption: Input image with grounded targets A and B

question: How many years apart were these actors' first credited feature-film appearances? (The actors playing the man raising both hands and the capped man.)

ra.condition: capped person on the right of the image

construction.ce: Within-image composition (m = 1, |S_1| = 2): compare first credited feature-film years as |tA − tB|.

turns.label: GR
turns.summary: Establish grounded identities and provenance for A and B
turns.input:
source_image: img_1
route: source annotations or visual analysis + retrieval
outputs: e_A + identity source, e_B + identity source

observation.text: In stage (a), source annotations or visual analysis and retrieval establish grounded identities (e_A, e_B) and identity provenance for internal construction.

turns.label: RA
turns.summary: Express targets through specific visual references
turns.input:
e_A → ν_A = "person raising both hands" (φ ≡ 1)
e_B → ν_B = "capped person on the right of the image" (φ ≡ 1)

observation.text: Specific visual references (φ ≡ 1, C(V, ν) = {e*}) use appearance, position, order, spatial relations, or occlusion to locate each target before retrieval instead of naming it directly: here, "person raising both hands" and "capped person on the right of the image".

turns.label: SR
turns.summary: Explore supporting evidence for each target separately
turns.input:
target A: retrieve year of first credited feature-film appearance → t_A
target B: retrieve year of first credited feature-film appearance → t_B

observation.text: The generator searches each target and records its retrieved facts, sources, and image provenance. In Figure 2(b), this retrieves Source for A (t_A = year) and Source for B (t_B = year).

turns.label: CE
turns.summary: Connect both facts through a joint comparison |tA − tB|
turns.input:
layout: within one image (A + B)
relation: |t_A − t_B| years
requirement: remove either fact → answer undetermined

observation.text: Within-image Compositional Evidence (m = 1, |S_1| ≥ 2) connects retrieved facts into a joint relation—here |t_A − t_B| years—requiring joint sufficiency and individual necessity: removing either t_A or t_B leaves the answer undetermined.

turns.label: PR
turns.summary: Run question-only search feedback to check for leakage
turns.input:
question: "How many years apart were these actors' first credited feature-film appearances?"
referents: "the man raising both hands and the capped man"
probe: bounded question-only search (no image)

observation.text: Static checks and a bounded question-only search probe test whether an identity or the answer can be recovered without the image; detected leakage guides changes to the references and relation, followed by renewed checks, or leads to discarding the task.

turns.label: TR
turns.summary: Collect verified teacher trajectories for supervised fine-tuning
turns.input: stage_c: (I, q) → Teacher (Qwen3.7-Plus) + tools → Keep trajectories with correct final answers → SFT (Qwen3.5-27B)

observation.text: In stage (c), the teacher (Qwen3.7-Plus) receives only (I, q) and solves retained tasks with search tools. Protocol-valid trajectories whose final answers are judged correct against reference answer a are retained for one SFT stage on Qwen3.5-27B.

takeaway: What changes? Specific visual references locate both actors without naming them, and |tA − tB| needs both actors' credits.
